service.ur: سماجی فلاح کی امداد کی درخواست

about: Apply for monthly social support for UAE national families on low income.
note: Requirements read from the official MOCD service page on the checked date. MOCD fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. The ministry is named MOCD in this file; its site is moce.gov.ae. Social welfare support application. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: UAE citizen living permanently in the UAE, primary beneficiary aged 21 or over
Total monthly family income and total assets must be below the set limits
Under 55 and able to work: must be employed and registered with a pension body, or retired
Age and work rules are waived for groups such as orphans, children of prisoners and people with certified medical conditions
documents: Detailed salary certificate for the head of household and wives
Proof of income from commercial licences
Extra documents by category, such as a court ruling, a medical report under 6 months old or a termination of service certificate
channels: MOCD website, sign in with UAE PASS
